description: This source file defines the PdfFormXObjectTable class, which manages external PDF form objects in the PDFsharp library. It handles importing external PDF pages, caching, and retrieving imported object tables associated with PDFs and pages.

classes.name: PdfFormXObjectTable
classes.description: Manages external PDF form XObjects imported into a PDF documents, caching external objects and providing access based on forms, pages, or documents.

classes.name: PdfFormXObjectTable.Selector
classes.description: A key class used to uniquely identify external imported object tables based on either a form, page, or document.

methods.name: PdfFormXObjectTable
methods.description: Constructor initializing the table with the target PdfDocument.

methods.name: GetForm
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a PdfFormXObject based on an XForm, handling external document lookup and singleton behavior.

methods.name: GetImportedObjectTable
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an imported object table associated with a specific PdfPage.

methods.name: GetImportedObjectTable
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an imported object table associated with a specific PdfDocument.

methods.name: DetachDocument
methods.description: Removes references to external documents from the internal cache when a document handle is no longer valid.
